key_findings: Dry-run evidence cannot count as real.
Six layers and ten surfaces are required.
Final audit was absent before L10.

findings.description: Final audit gate and tests were absent.
Missing metric impact was not enforced.

proposed_harness.name: final_audit_report_schema
proposed_harness.acceptance: Requires final audit source artifacts, generated reports, invariant results, missing impacts, P14 boundary, and findings.

proposed_harness.name: final_audit_gate_cli
proposed_harness.acceptance: Generates final_audit_report.json, final HTML/CSV copies, and exits nonzero on blocking invariant failure.

proposed_harness.name: final_audit_workflow_check
proposed_harness.acceptance: Workflow runs final gate, schema validation, and tests without P14 opt-in tokens.

implementation_plan.step: Implement final audit gate and schema.
implementation_plan.rationale: Produce a schema-valid L10 decision artifact.

risks: Final gate must avoid circular dependency on L10 stage_result.
Final gate must not use rendered views as metric source artifacts.
forbidden_shortcuts: Do not mark dry-run planner artifacts as real coverage.
Do not weaken existing tests or schemas.
notes: Harness design approved; final audit should compose existing source artifacts and add L10-specific invariants.
